pr_title: Clear UR bar marks after seeking
pr_body:
Fixes #14470 

* Supports both seeking with keybinds and with the mouse
* Clears the UR bar after seeking (as suggested by [this comment](https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14470#issuecomment-904279618))

I also had to expose the `SongProgressBar` in `SongProgress` as a read-only property to avoid `Drawable` hierarchy calls but can be easily refactored to use the hierarchy instead.

**Describe the bug:** 

When I seek while watching a reply, the UR bar ticks do not update to match the section proceeding the new location. It seems like updating the ticks fully could be an expensive operation (as it would require a lookbehind of sorts), so at least it would be nice to clear the UR bar after seeking.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

Here's an example in which the issue occurs several times. First, the replay plays and then I seek back to the start, and yet the ticks on the UR bar remain. Second, I repeatedly seek to an empty area of the map, and you see that the ticks fade out with real time rather than game time.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55752957/130532358-bc2d2d0e-454f-48d6-86a7-d5b3c5dad452.mp4
